title: Two Sum
description: Find a pair by tracking what you have already seen. Change the input and watch the map fill up.

title: Sliding Window
description: Move a fixed-size window without adding the same values again. Compare with a fresh sum each time.

title: Binary Search
description: Keep the possible interval visible while each comparison removes half the candidates.

title: Number of Islands
description: Watch depth-first search connect land cells, mark visits and return to the remaining frontier.

title: Balanced Binary Tree
description: See heights return from children to parents. Compare a repeated height scan with one postorder pass.

title: Consistent Hashing
description: Add a server to a hash ring and see exactly which keys change owner.

title: Key-Value Store
description: Write, read and delete values, then derive a sorted view from the same stored entries.

title: Lost Update
description: Interleave two stock updates and watch a correct-looking read-modify-write lose an update.

title: JavaScript Event Loop
description: Edit a small program and follow callbacks through the stack, microtasks and timers.

title: Request Sequence
description: Follow a cache hit and a cache miss across browser, API, cache and database.

title: C4 Architecture
description: Move from system context to containers while preserving responsibilities and ownership boundaries.

title: Reverse a Linked List
description: Save the next node before reversing a pointer. Watch the prefix and suffix change.

title: Coin Change
description: Build a dynamic-programming table from smaller amounts and inspect unreachable states.

title: Shortest Path with BFS
description: Follow a queue through a graph. Try a cycle or a destination that cannot be reached.

title: Retries without Duplicate Orders
description: A lost response triggers a retry. Compare creating twice with reusing an idempotency key.
